Revenge

The men who killed Aliya's fiancé Feyruz live in a manor northwest of the city outskirts. Aliya asks for help avenging him. Though they are experienced warriors, she hopes to catch them by surprise.

Objectives

Reach the meeting place

Approach the manor

Kill the manor's inhabitants

Collect the valuables

Aliya must survive
